licoes.objectivo: Dizer o que já está feito e o que não está com already / yet.

"We're on track" means...

exercicios.resposta: Yes, I've already booked it. It's room 3, on Friday at ten.

licoes.titulo: How long have you worked here?

opcoes.texto: How long have you worked here?
How long do you work here?
How long are you working here?

Which goes with "for"?
Which goes with "since"?

exercicios.resposta: I've worked at the bank for six years. I started in 2020.
